mcqs.question: PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana, which completed one year in October 2026, was launched on which date?
mcqs.explanation: PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana was launched on 11 October 2025. 16 July 2025 was the date of its Cabinet approval, while 2025–26 to 2030–31 denotes its six-year implementation period.

mcqs.question: Which Union Territory became the first in India to achieve 100% literacy under the ULLAS programme?
mcqs.explanation: Lakshadweep became the first Union Territory with 100% literacy under ULLAS on 11 October 2026, after all 1,113 identified illiterate adults passed FLNAT. Kavaratti is the capital of Lakshadweep, while ULLAS is the literacy programme, not a Union Territory.
